from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class DocumentInfo(BaseModel):
    """Information extracted from a single judgment document."""
    title: str | None = Field(description="The title of the judgment document")
    legal_relationship: str | None = Field(description="The core legal nature of the case as described (e.g., Administrative Compensation, Administrative Reconsideration, Civil Enforcement)")
    administrative_subject: str | None = Field(description="The type of entity acting as the administrative or procedural subject (e.g., Government Agency, Court, Lawyer Association)")
    dispute_focus: str | None = Field(description="The specific act or decision being challenged or reviewed (e.g., Administrative Punishment, Demolition, Reconsideration Decision)")
    parties: list[str] | None = Field(description="The parties involved in the case, including individuals and organizations")
    key_legal_terms: list[str] | None = Field(description="Keywords or phrases extracted that indicate the legal category (e.g., 'Administrative Reconsideration', 'Civil Execution')")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    documents: list[DocumentInfo]
